official_rules.note: N1 is sat as one 110-minute 言語知識（文字・語彙・文法）・読解 paper plus 聴解 (60 minutes before December 2022, 55 minutes from December 2022 onward), and is scored in three 60-point blocks (言語知識 / 読解 / 聴解) with a 19-point benchmark in each and a 90/180 pass mark. This simulation covers the written paper — 聴解 is sat separately as an original TTS-based listening block (no official recordings).
